response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile engineer with a genuine tooling/testing background, but his stack centers on TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and web development rather than the required Java/Kotlin/JVM expertise. He lists Java only as a peripheral skill, shows no Kotlin or Spring ecosystem experience, and has no meaningful enterprise framework or application-server background. Brief IDE work (LabWindows/CVI in C/C++, ~7 months) and open-source developer tooling show interest in the space, but the core required qualifications are largely unmet.
strengths: Long, diverse engineering career with demonstrated craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD, testing tools)
Genuine interest in developer tooling — built test runners, assertion libraries, and MCP code generators
Some direct IDE development experience (NI LabWindows/CVI) and low-latency systems work
concerns: No substantive Java/Kotlin or JVM-internals experience; Java only mentioned peripherally
No Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or enterprise application-server exposure
Recent career focused on full-stack web/TypeScript, not large-scale language tooling or IDE subsystems
